# 从 Phonopy 文件到三维中子散射: # From Phonopy files to three-dimensional neutron scattering
在计算中心打开“Phonopy 模 → 中子散射”，或从现有 Phonopy 导: Open Phonopy modes → Neutron scattering in the calculation center, or create a new input copy from an existing Phonopy import. The tool uses all frequencies and 3N complex eigenvectors at the selected supplied q point, together with the lattice, positions and masses of the same primitive cell. The existing animation, frozen-mode and one-dimensional chain tools retain their own inputs.
## 按同一份数据完成计算: ## Complete the calculation from one consistent dataset
1. 载入包含复本征矢的 qpoints.yaml、band.yaml 或 me: 1. Load qpoints.yaml, band.yaml or mesh.yaml containing complex eigenvectors, and supply the primitive structure from the same calculation when needed. Its atom order must match the vectors. Frequencies alone, one animated mode or species counts do not replace the complete ordered mode space.
2. 核对频率、长度和质量单位，确认采用 Phonopy 的原子位置相位约定及配: 2. Check frequency, length and mass units, and confirm the Phonopy atomic-position phase convention and paired primitive-cell order. Resolve conflicts between file declarations and selected units before calculation. THz denotes cyclic frequency, converted with hν; cm⁻¹ and meV use their explicitly declared conversions.
3. 选择原文件中的 q 索引和整数倒格位移 G，或输入完整 Q 并声明其坐标。: 3. Select a supplied q index and integer reciprocal offset G, or enter full Q with its coordinate convention. Creation requires Q−q to be an integer reciprocal vector; annihilation requires Q+q to be one. The calculation retains the file’s original q representative and vectors, and reports the matching residual.
4. 输入逐原子或逐物种的实相干中子散射长度，单位 fm，并保留其来源。这个有符: 4. Enter real coherent neutron lengths per atom or per species in fm, retaining their source. These signed lengths enter amplitudes; they are not atomic probabilities or cross sections to add directly. The ZnO example uses the NIST natural-isotope averages, 5.680 fm for Zn and 5.803 fm for O.
5. 明确选择 Debye–Waller 处理：将其省略作为受控近似，或提供同一: 5. Choose the Debye–Waller treatment explicitly: omit it as a controlled approximation, or supply Cartesian displacement tensors in Å² for the same primitive cell, atom order and temperature. Zero temperature still has zero-point motion and does not automatically imply zero displacement.
6. 设置温度、正频能量截断、能量窗口和 Gaussian 标准差后，手动计算。: 6. Set temperature, positive-energy cutoff, energy window and Gaussian standard deviation, then calculate manually. Inspect units, mode completeness and momentum matching before following atomic projections, structural phases, amplitude sums and spectral weights. Result selectors browse the current reply.
7. 导出时保留两份实际输入、计算条件和结果。研究记录中的输入副本可以重新编辑后: 7. Retain both actual inputs, calculation conditions and results when exporting. A research-record input copy can be edited and run manually. Copying or opening a record neither calculates nor rewrites the source record.
原胞晶格 A 按行存储，单位 Å；不含 2π 的倒易行基为 B=A⁻ᵀ。原胞倒易: The primitive lattice A stores rows in Å, with reciprocal row basis B=A⁻ᵀ excluding 2π. Primitive reciprocal fractions give Qcart=2π Qfrac B; Cartesian input converts back as Qfrac=Qcart Aᵀ/(2π). A nonorthogonal lattice requires the full matrix, rather than treating its three fractional components as Cartesian components.
创建通道的原子项为 aj=bj exp(−Wj) exp[2πi G·rj] [: For creation, atom j contributes aj=bj exp(−Wj) exp[2πi G·rj] [Qcart·conjugate(ej)]/√mj, where G=Qfrac−qfrac. Contract the three Cartesian components of each atom first, then add the complex atomic amplitudes coherently. Squaring Cartesian components separately would change the calculation.
Phonopy 模式含有原子位置相位。若把 q 改成等价的另一个倒易代表，向量也: Phonopy modes include an atomic-position phase. Replacing q by another reciprocal representative requires the corresponding atomic phase transformation of the vectors. The tool therefore matches the original supplied q. Missing points require additional data; nearby points or vectors from another representative are not substituted.
湮灭通道使用实际匹配 Q+q 为倒格向量的输入模式，其原子项使用 ej 和 ex: Annihilation uses an actual supplied mode with Q+q reciprocal, with ej and exp[2πi(Qfrac+qfrac)·rj] in its atomic term. Both channels check their required data separately; the opposite mode is not inferred from external input with undeclared time-reversal properties.
## 热运动、能量与强度单位: ## Thermal motion, energy and intensity units
提供热位移张量 Uj 时，Wj=Qcart Uj Qcartᵀ/2。工具核对温度: For a supplied tensor Uj, Wj=Qcart Uj Qcartᵀ/2. The tool checks temperature, Å² units, atom count, symmetry and positive semidefiniteness, and records the conditions actually used. Four independent q points do not form a complete thermal mesh and cannot supply invented finite-temperature ZnO tensors.
未被截断的正能量分支按 C|Σj aj|²/E 形成裸线权重，C=ℏ²/(2 a: Retained positive-energy branches have bare line weight C|Σj aj|²/E, with C=ℏ²/(2 amu) converted using Å and meV. Creation multiplies by n+1 at energy transfer +E; annihilation multiplies by n at −E. Nonpositive frequencies and terms below the cutoff are excluded before evaluating inverse energy or occupation.
采用 fm 的散射长度后，积分线权重为 fm²，单位面积的 meV Gaussi: With lengths in fm, integrated line weights are in fm² and unit-area meV Gaussian densities are in fm²/meV. Results are per primitive cell with final/initial probe-wavevector ratio k′/k=1. Experimental comparison requires consistent Debye–Waller treatment, probe kinematics and sample normalization. The supplied broadening is a resolution model, not a calculated lifetime.
完整能量轴上的线权重与有限窗口积分分别显示；Gaussian 窗口积分用误差函数: Full-axis line weights and finite-window integrals are reported separately. Gaussian window integrals use the error function, with sampled integration reported independently. Weight outside a narrow displayed window does not mean that a mode has disappeared.
## 相位、完整基与数值分组: ## Phase, complete bases and numerical grouping
每个参与本次通道的 q 点必须包含完整的 3N 个有限复向量，并通过范数与 Gr: Each q point participating in the selected channels must contain all 3N finite complex vectors and pass norm and Gram checks. A supplied dynamical matrix is checked for Hermiticity and Rayleigh eigenpair residuals; unknown matrix units are not automatically checked against the frequency conversion factor. Without it, vector orthogonality does not independently recompute force constants or establish material-frequency accuracy.
同一模式的整体相位只改变振幅相位，不改强度。在真正同能的子空间内，单支强度依赖所: A mode’s common phase changes amplitude phase but not strength. Within a genuinely equal-energy subspace, individual strengths depend on basis and the complete subspace sum should be compared. Results show the numerical grouping tolerance and energy spread. Near-energy groups retain each branch’s actual energy and weight in the spectrum, rather than replacing them by a mean eigenenergy.
## ZnO 参考的实际条件: ## Actual conditions of the ZnO reference
示例复用本站分发的两份固定 ZnO 文件，原始字节、来源、许可证和 Phonop: The example reuses the two pinned ZnO files distributed with the site, retaining byte identity, provenance, licensing and the Phonopy 4.10.0 generation conditions. Its primitive cell contains Zn, Zn, O, O and 12 branches, with complete modes at four supplied q points. NAC was disabled during generation; the presence of a separate BORN file does not make these frequencies LO–TO-corrected results.
ZnO 中子示例的原子长度另有 NIST 来源。显示的是给定声子与探针条件下计算: The neutron lengths used for ZnO have a separate NIST source. The displayed signal is computed from the supplied phonons and probe conditions; it is neither a new DFT calculation nor a measured ZnO spectrum. Other momenta require complete corresponding modes from the same model with consistent primitive-cell, unit and phase conventions.
- [Phonopy 动态结构因子](https://phonopy.githu: - [Phonopy dynamic structure factor](https://phonopy.github.io/phonopy/dynamic-structure-factor.html) and its [pinned v4.10.0 implementation](https://github.com/phonopy/phonopy/blob/v4.10.0/phonopy/spectrum/dynamic_structure_factor.py): one-phonon channels and structure-factor conventions.
- [Phonopy output formats](https://phonopy.github.io/phonopy/output-files.html) and [dynamical-matrix/displacement conventions](https://phonopy.github.io/phonopy/formulation.html#dynamical-matrix): supplied-mode formats and conventions.
- [NIST 中子散射长度表](https://www.ncnr.nist.g: - [NIST neutron scattering-length table](https://www.ncnr.nist.gov/resources/n-lengths/list.html): real bound coherent lengths for natural Zn and O in fm.
教学过程的数值检查验证计算与输入关系；它们不代替实验收敛分析，也不构成学生学习效: Instructional numerical checks verify the relation between inputs and calculation. They do not replace experimental convergence analysis or measure student learning outcomes.
## 从完整模式进入三维中子散射: ## From complete modes to three-dimensional neutron scattering
把当前两份原始输入复制到独立的“Phonopy 模 → 中子散射”工具，可在补齐: Copy the two current source inputs into the independent Phonopy modes → Neutron scattering tool, complete the unit, primitive-order, probe-length and thermal conditions, and calculate manually. That tool rereads all 3N complex vectors at each required supplied q; the selected-mode animation here retains its original purpose. See [Three-dimensional Phonopy neutron scattering](phonopy-scattering.md).
## 将相干求和用于真实 Phonopy 模: ## Apply coherent sums to supplied Phonopy modes
学会本页的逐原子求和后，可从[Phonopy 三维中子散射工具](phonopy: After learning atomic coherent addition here, use the [Phonopy three-dimensional neutron-scattering tool](phonopy-scattering.md) with complete supplied modes. Three-dimensional projections, primitive phases and physical probe lengths are declared separately there; this diatomic-chain input and replay do not automatically become material data.
